title: Is the Pacific Garbage Patch Visible From Space?

scenes.text: The Pacific's 1.6‑million‑square‑mile garbage patch looks like a floating island from orbit.
scenes.query2: Pacific Ocean plastic debris from space

scenes.text: Myth: You can see the massive trash swirl with the naked eye from space.
scenes.label: Visible from space?

scenes.text: Truth: The debris is mostly micro‑plastics spread thinly; even astronauts report it looks like ordinary water.
scenes.label: Micro‑plastics, not visible
scenes.query: astronaut statement Pacific garbage patch invisible
scenes.query2: NASA crew view of ocean plastic

scenes.label: Tiny, huge impact
scenes.sub: Micro‑plastics spread over millions of square miles

description: We all hear the giant trash island floating in the Pacific, but can you really spot it from orbit? The truth will surprise you. Follow for more mind‑blowing facts.
